mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the labor market tightness supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening in the real economy, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals a restrictive monetary policy environment that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion (INDPRO growth rate > 0.5% monthly), the strengthening supply chain supports corporate production and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO growth rate > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
